title: Judgment Sieve: Reducing Uncertainty in Group Judgments through Interventions Targeting Ambiguity versus Disagreement
reasoning: The paper focuses on a workflow for human annotation to reduce ambiguity and disagreement in group judgments. While it uses toxicity detection as a test case, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems, focusing instead on the technical methodology of crowdsourcing and uncertainty management.
